subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41937dbdc21edeb1021d9525ab692c80f1023b4fffc706355c1b177aa9974d50.png]
solution:
Logic followed here is,

From the first figure to second figure, the arrow remain at the same place and circle change in triangle.

And from the second figure to third figure, the arrow move to opposite side and triangle change in diamond.

From the third figure to fourth figure, the arrow remain at the same place and diamond change in circle.</sp
